name: Allegra Campana
source:
Allegra is a character who uses anger to build a wall between herself and the MC. Because she is so accustomed to her (self-inflicted) isolation, she isn’t used to working around other people. This contributes to her clumsy interactions with the MC, most of which result in emotional strife.

When given the opportunity to teach MC new skills, Allegra has little to base her teaching style upon, aside from the unpleasant memories of her parents and their disappointment in her skills. On top of this, Allegra was bullied out of design school, and returned home to yet more of her parents' disappointment. This bullying contributes to slight trust issues, although she easily opens up to the MC when approached gently and with kindness.

[From strategy guide]
